preconditions.name: enough_divergent_seeds
preconditions.description: number of seeds whose candidate pool is DIVERGENT on ALL C1 comparison arms (A0 + A1 + ARM_NOISE) >= MIN_DIVERGENT_SEEDS. Per-seed-divergent gating; too few => substrate_not_ready_requeue (pool too collapsed to test conversion).
preconditions.control: consumed cand_world_summary pairwise spread > floor (GAP-A); per-seed

preconditions.name: loops_carry_live_cross_loop_variance
preconditions.description: ARC-110 NON-DEGENERACY guard (what_would_answer): on A1_LOOPS a non-motor loop must FLIP the within-eligible winner (loop_committed_neq_motor_winner) or the loops must DISAGREE (loop_cross_loop_winner_disagreement) on a non-trivial fraction of P2 ticks, AND a non-motor loop must carry per-loop preference RANGE > 0 -- on a majority of seeds. A loop pinned to the motor winner is a vacuous split => substrate_not_ready_requeue. measured = min across A1 seeds of the flip fraction.
preconditions.control: A1_LOOPS loop_frac_committed_neq_motor / loop_frac_disagree + per-loop pref range

preconditions.name: named_channel_routing_live
preconditions.description: ARC-110 C2 RELEASE non-degeneracy gate (707b): on A1_LOOPS at least one LIMBIC channel (ofc/liking/vigour) must reach the segregated-loop arbitration carrying a routed per-candidate RANGE > LIMBIC_ROUTED_RANGE_FLOOR (peak over P2 ticks), on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds. This is the MECH-191 phasic-externalisation gate: the named bias HEADS emit per-candidate-FLAT output, so without the use_named_channel_routing release the limbic loop is inert and ARM_DROP_LIMBIC is byte-identical to A1 (the 707 vacuous DROP==A1). Evaluated BEFORE C2 is scored. measured = max across A1 seeds of the limbic routed range; SAME statistic (per-candidate range) the load-bearing C2 ablation depends on, not a magnitude proxy.
preconditions.control: A1_LOOPS loop_limbic_routed_range_max (peak limbic routed per-candidate range over P2)

preconditions.name: in_layer_null_live
preconditions.description: 707a FIX (supersedes in_layer_null_verified_lifting): the S2 IN-LAYER same-layer null (ARM_NOISE: magnitude-matched random structure at the non-motor loop accumulators) is a LIVE perturbation -- it actively perturbs the committed selection (loop_noise_active_ticks > 0 AND loop_frac_committed_neq_motor or loop_frac_disagree > the cross-loop-variance floor) on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds. This is the SAME-LAYER null the single arena could NOT construct (704b/706b binding constraint); a null that does NOT reach the committed-class readout makes C1's strict-above-null bar meaningless => substrate_not_ready_requeue (NOT a weakens). The RETIRED 707 proxy required the null to LIFT entropy strict-above A0 -- the 700-lineage TEMPERATURE-null liveness test, INVALID for a structured-accumulator null: random magnitude-matched loop content lands at baseline, not above it (structured beats random; random ~ A0), so it spuriously requeued a valid result and made the WEAKENS branch unreachable. The path-artifact hypothesis is ruled out by C1 (A1 strict-above the live null), NOT by null-lift. measured = n divergent seeds the null is LIVE on (n_noise_lifts recorded separately for continuity, no longer gates).
preconditions.control: ARM_NOISE loop_frac_committed_neq_motor / loop_frac_disagree + loop_noise_active_ticks, divergent seeds

preconditions.name: learning_engaged_finer_channels_dissociable_delta_nonflat
preconditions.description: on A1_LOOPS the finer w_chan_finer entries MOVED + carry cross-channel range above floor AND the signed-RPE delta_t carries cross-tick variance, on a majority of seeds -- learning is engaged (else the loops are reading an un-trained gate). Below floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.name: candidate_pool_divergent
preconditions.description: consumed cand_world_summaries (e2.world_forward) per-candidate SPREAD clears the floor on a majority of seeds (GAP-A non-vacuity).
preconditions.control: SD-056 e2 trained online in P0; candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward

same_layer_null.layer: ARC-110 S2: the eligibility/settling field at the non-motor loop accumulators (the SAME layer the per-loop settling acts on; NOT policy softmax temperature, the decoupled 700-lineage null)
same_layer_null.mechanism: config.e3.loop_segregation_noise_on=True -> _loop_inlayer_null replaces each non-motor loop accumulator with a magnitude-matched random-structure (gaussian) perturbation, range == loop_segregation_noise_alpha x the real loop accumulator range. Motor (F) is never nulled. Selection-only (no memory write).

evidence_direction_note: NARROW (governance 2026-06-29, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-707b_2026-06-29 CONFIRMED, user-approved): weakens the single-arena-artefact SUB-hypothesis ONLY; does NOT falsify ARC-110 (segregated loops biologically real + load-bearing). Conversion ceiling confirmed INTRINSIC to MECH-439 F-dominance, not a single-arena artefact. Missing dependency = dopamine-gated cross-loop arbitration plasticity (MECH-448/449/ARC-107). ARC-110 stays candidate/substrate_conditional, pending_retest_after_substrate=true; PROMOTES NOTHING; fires contingent MECH-439 /claim-synthesis. Original note follows. -- V3-EXQ-707b ARC-110 LOOP-SEGREGATION C2 RELEASE VALIDATION (supersedes V3-EXQ-707a/707; experiment_purpose=diagnostic; claim_ids=[ARC-110]; PROMOTES NOTHING). 707b LANDS THE C2 RELEASE: a no-op-default flag use_named_channel_routing routes each named channel's per-candidate REPRESENTATION through project_channel_range (range-preserving, the GAP-A path) into the segregated loops, so the limbic loop (ofc/liking/vigour) carries REAL per-candidate range and ARM_DROP_LIMBIC can differ from A1 -- making C2 (limbic load-bearing) testable. 707/707a left C2 substrate-blocked: the named bias HEADS emit per-candidate-FLAT output (MECH-191 phasic gap), so DROP_LIMBIC was byte-identical to A1 (vacuous). A NEW per-named-channel non-degeneracy precondition (named_channel_routing_live: a limbic channel's routed range > floor on a strict-majority of divergent seeds) is evaluated BEFORE C2 is scored, so the vacuous DROP==A1 self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (NEVER a false weakens). The 707a in-layer-null LIVENESS gate (null must PERTURB committed selection, not raise entropy above A0) and C1 (A1 strict-above max(A0, the live null)+margin) are UNCHANGED. config_summary.design: 4-arm ARC-110 loop-segregation validation (A0_SINGLE_ARENA / A1_LOOPS / ARM_NOISE in-layer null / ARM_DROP_LIMBIC) + per-seed-divergent gating + live-cross-loop-variance non-degeneracy gate + LIVE in-layer same-layer null gate (707a: null-liveness, not null-lift)
config_summary.arms: A0_SINGLE_ARENA (use_loop_segregation=False) / A1_LOOPS (ARC-110 motor/assoc/limbic + ARC-109 D1/D2 + MECH-452 loop-local traces) / ARM_NOISE (A1 + loop_segregation_noise_on) / ARM_DROP_LIMBIC (A1, limbic loop remapped into associative)
config_summary.swept_variables: use_loop_segregation (A0 off, loop arms on) + loop_segregation_noise_on (ARM_NOISE) + limbic-loop channel-map ablation (ARM_DROP_LIMBIC). Finer-channel gating + learned settling ON on ALL arms.
config_summary.the_isolated_factor: loop segregation only: A0 runs the single-arena within-eligible argmin over the finer channels; A1 partitions the SAME finer channels into motor=F / associative=dACC+lPFC / limbic=OFC+liking+vigour loops with within-loop competition first + Haber ascending-spiral arbitration after + per-loop zscore normalisation (strips F's magnitude advantage). D1/D2 + loop-local traces are inert without loops, so the functional swept variable IS loop segregation.
config_summary.matched_constant_arithmetic_envelope: use_f_eligibility_demotion=True + use_f_eligibility_adaptive_floor=True (689e) + use_go_nogo_constitution=True (689g) + use_modulatory_selection_authority=True (643a) + use_modulatory_channel_routing (cand_world_summary) + top_k shortlist (k=3, 569i)
config_summary.matched_diversity_stack: MECH-341 stratified + use_dacc (MECH-260 perseveration No-Go feed) + use_gated_policy + use_lateral_pfc_analog (lateral_pfc_train_rule_bias_head=True, TRAINED in P1 REINFORCE) + SD-056 all levers + the matured/maintained CRF pool + use_candidate_rule_field + use_finer_channel_gating=True + use_learned_settling_step=True
config_summary.settling_W_lat: ON on ALL arms (the within-loop settling each segregated loop runs; on A0 the legacy single-arena settling)
config_summary.primary_dv: committed-action-class entropy (nats), interpreted on divergent seeds only
config_summary.phases: P0 e2-train (CRF matures, finer gating ON) -> P1 frozen-encoder bias-head REINFORCE -> P2 e2+bias frozen, gating + loops KEEP adapting
config_summary.learning_wiring: w_chan_finer learns via e3.post_action_update driven by agent.update_residue every waking tick; on the loop arms credit is loop-local (MECH-452); the S2 null is selection-only (no learning write)
config_summary.drop_limbic_channel_map: limbic channels remapped into associative -> limbic loop empty (per-loop ablation)
config_summary.use_differentiable_cem: NOT FLIPPED (default False; SD-055 safety note)
config_summary.arc110_relationship: this IS the ARC-110 validation -- the gate cleared by 704b FAIL-to-convert; supports => single-arena collapse was a binding constraint, weakens => ceiling intrinsic

interpretation_grid.PASS_loop_segregation_converts_limbic_lo: preconditions met (ENOUGH divergent seeds + loops carry LIVE cross-loop variance + the in-layer null is LIVE + learning engaged) AND C1 (A1_LOOPS committed-class entropy strict-above A0_SINGLE_ARENA AND the valid in-layer null on a strict-majority of divergent seeds) AND C2 (A1 strict-above ARM_DROP_LIMBIC -- the limbic loop is load-bearing). Loop segregation CONVERTS committed-action diversity where the single F-dominated arena plateaued -> the single-arena collapse WAS a binding constraint on the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) -> supports ARC-110.
interpretation_grid.PASS_loop_segregation_converts_limbic_no: preconditions + C1 met BUT NOT C2 (dropping the limbic loop does NOT remove the lift). Loop segregation converts, but the associative loop (or the loop structure per se) carries it -- the limbic loop is not the sole driver. Still supports ARC-110 (segregation converts); the per-loop load-bearing attribution is partial.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_valid_null_loops_vary_but_no_conver: DECISIVE. preconditions met (a VALID in-layer null can now be constructed -- ARM_NOISE is a LIVE perturbation of the committed selection -- and the loops carry live cross-loop variance) BUT A1_LOOPS does NOT lift committed-class entropy strict-above A0/the null. The single-arena collapse was NOT the binding constraint -> the F-dominance conversion ceiling is INTRINSIC, not an artefact of collapse -> weakens ARC-110 (the loop-segregation-as-artefact hypothesis).
interpretation_grid.FAIL_substrate_not_ready_requeue: A precondition is unmet: too FEW divergent seeds (pool collapsed), OR the loops carry NO live cross-loop variance (a vacuous split pinned to the motor winner -- the ARC-110 what_would_answer guard), OR the NAMED limbic channels carry NO routed per-candidate range (named_channel_routing_live=false -- the MECH-191 phasic gap unfixed, so ARM_DROP_LIMBIC is a no-op = the 707 vacuous DROP==A1, and C2 cannot be validly scored), OR the S2 in-layer null is INERT (does NOT perturb the committed selection even with loops -> null-validity problem persists), OR learning was not engaged (finer channels not dissociable / delta_t flat). The conversion question could NOT be measured -- NOT a falsification.
